ops.oldText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, OR A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED AN AMOUNT EQUAL TO 12 MONTHS' FEES PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have replaced the single-transaction limiter with a mutual cap equal to 12 months' fees, since a transaction-level cap can fall well below six months' fees. We have also expanded the existing Section 8 carve-out so indemnification obligations, confidentiality breaches and gross negligence or willful misconduct sit outside the cap for both parties; this is our fallback position on limitation of liability.
proposal.summary: Make Section 9 a mutual cap equal to 12 months' fees and carve indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct out of the cap.

mappings.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT
